founding_year.basis: Schedule A: Philippe Laffont, founder, title acquired 12/1999; the CTEK fund's prospectus says the adviser was founded in 1999.

history.value: Philippe Laffont founded Coatue in New York in 1999 as a technology hedge fund after working at Tiger Management, and his brother Thomas built its private investing. Since 2013 its venture and growth funds have backed Snap, Uber, Spotify, DoorDash, Anthropic and OpenAI. Its private funds hold about $40 billion of the $93 billion the firm manages, and the track record on this page covers the private investments only.
history.basis: Founding year, city and founder from the ADV and the CTEK prospectus; Tiger Management from Wikipedia; the bets are portfolio rows on this page; the asset figures are the ADV's (2026-07-29): RAUM $92,705,722,582 and $40,532,176,864 of gross assets in the 111 private-markets master funds. Moved off the page: the public-markets funds (flagship long/short, long only, quant) are the other strategy desk and are not part of the portfolio shown (decisions.md D2, D3); offices in Menlo Park, San Francisco, Hong Kong and London; the registered CTEK fund launched in May 2025.

investment_concept.value: “Investing in innovation through public and private markets with responsible risk management.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from the homepage (the h1 line above the footer, read 2026-09-26); a closing period is the only edit. The homepage hero itself is an animated typewriter with no fixed headline.

investment_range.source: companies/classification.json (the cited entry rounds of 177 members); sources/edgar/formd-sweep.json; the fund table
investment_range.basis: MEDIAN: press-based. 177 member rows state the size of the round in which Coatue is first named; their median is $100M (25th percentile $34M, 75th $250M; Seed rows $11M, Series A rows $25M, Growth rows $150M), published as $100M. It is a ROUND-SIZE PROXY for check size, not the firm's cheque: Coatue leads many of these rounds but shares the large ones. The Form D layer was refused as the base for the median because it covers only 25 members (median $37M) and misses the growth rounds that never name a Coatue person. LOWER LIMIT: $3M, the smallest documented entry rounds (Fero's seed of November 2023, Lutra's $3.8M seed). UPPER LIMIT: $500M, which is 13% of the largest fund with a sworn size (Coatue Growth Fund V, $3.87B) and matches the largest rounds the firm led on the record (Firmus $505M, April 2026; Scala $500M with IMCO, September 2024). Rounds above that size in which Coatue took part (Anthropic, OpenAI) are shared rounds and were not read as its cheque.

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's companies, most recognised first (PRO-152). Also considered: Anthropic, Stripe, DoorDash, ByteDance, Databricks, Instacart, Reddit.

aum.basis: The venture desk's floor, both ends (COLLECTION.md 1, strategy desks): the sum of Section 7.B.(1) gross asset values of the 111 private-markets MASTER funds on Coatue Management, L.L.C.'s Form ADV (CRD 157910, other-than-annual amendment of 2026-07-29), feeders excluded because their assets sit in their masters. The adviser's Item 5.F regulatory assets, $92,705,722,582, cover the public-markets funds as well and never fill this field. Of the floor, $8,197,006,313 sits in 85 single-deal co-investment vehicles.

Morgan (they feed the funds above), about 130 single-deal co-investment vehicles (Coatue CT / US / (Cayman) nn), Coatue Growth Fund VI (2026; only its private-investor feeders have filed so far), and the public-markets funds, which are the other strategy desk.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 9 West 57th Street 25th Floor, New York, NY (COATUE MANAGEMENT, L.L.C., CRD 157910, Other-Than-Annual Amendment filed 2026-07-29). The firm's site lists New York, NY; Menlo Park, CA; San Francisco, CA; Hong Kong, Hong Kong; London, United Kingdom; the principal office is among them, so the site agrees. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.

investment_scope.basis: Derived: the firm's page carries no sector filter, so the scope is read from the portfolio. The eight sectors listed each hold at least 20 of the 381 members (profile.focus_min_companies): Consumer & Marketplaces 74, Fintech & Payments 56, SaaS 53, AI & Applied AI 31, Healthcare & Bio 25, DevTools & APIs 25, Industrial & Robotics 25, Data Infrastructure 24. Below the floor: Media, Gaming & Advertising 19, Crypto & Web3 16, Security 16, Climate & Energy 15. The firm describes itself as a technology investor; across eight sectors that reads Generalist in this taxonomy.
